title: Micron Technology (MU): A Clear Beneficiary of the AI Infrastructure Buildout?

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 9:44 AM EDT 3 min read

TCW Funds, an investment management firm, published its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the 'TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund.' A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. During the second quarter, AI monetization, a fragile Middle East ceasefire, and a Federal Reserve leadership transition were the significant events. All major indices ended higher, driven by resilient economic growth and strong corporate earnings. April marked a recovery from March lows, with the S&P 500 achieving record highs by early June, largely due to robust corporate earnings linked to AI capital spending. Although the fund appreciated 14.45% in the quarter, it trailed the Russell 1000® Growth Index's 16.74% and the S&P 500's 15.20% returns. Holdings in healthcare and financials hurt relative results most, while information technology and consumer discretionary holdings positively impacted relative performance during the quarter.  Please review the Fund's top five holdings to gain insights into their key selections for 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund highlighted Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) as a newly added position. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) is a leading semiconductor company that manufactures memory and storage products, delivering solutions for a wide range of applications. On August 12, 2026, Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) closed at $911.29 per share. The one-month return of Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) was 6.81%, and its shares gained 627.34% over the past 52 weeks. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has a market capitalization of $1.03 trillion.

TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund stated the following regarding Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of memory technologies specializing in DRAM, NAND flash and NOR flash memory products. We believe the company is a clear beneficiary of the AI infrastructure buildout as the rapid expansion of AI workloads has shifted memory from a historically commodity component to a mission-critical strategic asset. The global semiconductor market is highly oligopolistic, with Micron (sole U.S. manufacturer), Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix holding over 90% market share. Driven by the AI infrastructure buildout, industry demand currently exceeds supply, and we believe this will persist for the foreseeable future. Longer-term customer supply agreements provide earnings visibility across Micron's highest value products and reduce spot-market exposure. We are attracted to Micron's competitive position in a secularly growing market, and we believe the current price understates the long-term cash flow and earnings power of the business."

投资管理公司 TCW Funds 发布了“TCW 集中大盘成长基金”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 第二季度的重大事件包括人工智能货币化、脆弱的中东停火以及美联储领导层换届。 在经济增长强劲和企业盈利强劲的推动下，所有主要股指均收高。 4 月份标志着标准普尔 500 指数从 3 月份的低点开始复苏，到 6 月初，标准普尔 500 指数创下了历史新高，这主要是由于与人工智能资本支出相关的强劲企业盈利。 尽管该基金在本季度升值了 14.45%，但仍落后于 Russell 1000® 增长指数的 16.74% 和标准普尔 500 指数的 15.20% 回报率。 医疗保健和金融领域的持股对相对业绩的影响最大，而信息技术和非必需消费品领域的持股则对本季度的相对业绩产生了积极影响。 请回顾该基金的前五名持股，以深入了解其 2026 年的主要选择。

TCW Concentration Large Cap Growth Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中强调，美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）是新增加的头寸。 美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）是一家领先的半导体公司，生产内存和存储产品，为各种应用提供解决方案。 2026 年 8 月 12 日，美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）收于每股 911.29 美元。 美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）1个月回报率为6.81%，过去52周股价上涨627.34%。 美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）的市值为 1.03 万亿美元。

TCW Concentration Large Cap Growth Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）发表了以下声明：

“美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）是全球领先的内存技术制造商之一，专注于 DRAM、NAND 闪存和 NOR 闪存产品。 我们认为，该公司是人工智能基础设施建设的明显受益者，因为人工智能工作负载的快速扩张已将内存从历史上的商品组件转变为任务关键型战略资产。 全球半导体市场高度寡头垄断，美光（美国唯一制造商）、三星电子和SK海力士占据90%以上的市场份额。 在人工智能基础设施建设的推动下，目前行业供不应求，我们相信这种情况在可预见的未来将持续存在。 长期客户供应协议可提供美光最高价值产品的盈利可见性，并减少现货市场风险。 我们被美光科技在长期增长的市场中的竞争地位所吸引，我们认为目前的价格低估了该业务的长期现金流和盈利能力。”
